summary: Run the existing bounded root-zone budget over a finite supplied set of provenance-labeled scenarios under one shared forcing schedule, then display their daywise envelope without treating it as a probability distribution or confidence interval.
objective: Compare a finite supplied ensemble of root-zone budget assumptions under identical forcing and reveal scenario spread, threshold crossings and invalid members without duplicating the underlying water-balance model.
intent_signals: Compare finite irrigation assumptions under one forcing schedule.
Show a provenance-labeled root-zone scenario envelope without probabilistic claims.
example_prompts: Compare five supplied TAW, initial-depletion and capillary-rise scenarios against the same 14-day weather and irrigation ledger.
not_for: Probabilistic uncertainty, crop-yield forecasting, field-system sizing or replacing the underlying root-zone budget.

entities.name: Shared forcing ledger
entities.guidance: Hash one finite daily precipitation, runoff, irrigation and ETc schedule used unchanged by every scenario; display any intentionally shared capillary-rise input explicitly.

entities.name: Scenario registry
entities.guidance: Store 2..32 stable scenario IDs, provenance, TAW, D0, optional RAW parameter and every declared differing input; absence remains unavailable rather than sampled.

entities.name: Envelope and members
entities.guidance: At day i show accepted member D_i curves and their finite min/max band; show invalid members and stop days separately instead of dropping them silently.

state_contract.model: Compose recipe.root-zone-irrigation-budget without changing its equations. Accept 2..32 finite supplied scenarios with unique IDs/provenance and one byte-identical shared forcing ledger hash. Run the canonical budget independently for each scenario. A daywise envelope is available only over an explicitly named set of accepted members and equals [min_s D_s,i, max_s D_s,i]; preserve individual traces and invalid stop reasons. Scenario membership carries no probability unless an external probability model is separately supplied and reviewed.
state_contract.authority: The shared forcing hash, finite supplied scenario registry/provenance, explicit accepted-member set and each underlying canonical budget ledger own state. Blender/glTF provides one static neutral prism/forcing rail/glyph set; Three.js calls the related budget contract per member, computes only the declared descriptive min/max envelope, exposes failures and resets membership and forcing exactly.
actions: Select the fixed scenario set and shared forcing ledger.
Inspect threshold crossings and invalid stop reasons.
Change one supplied scenario assumption without changing shared forcing.
Reset membership, forcing and selected day.

invariants: Every member references the identical shared forcing hash.
Envelope extrema are recomputed from the visibly declared accepted-member set; failed or missing members are never silently omitted.
The envelope is labeled a finite scenario range, not likelihood, quantile, confidence or forecast skill.
Underlying daily conservation and bounds remain owned by recipe.root-zone-irrigation-budget.
motion_guidance: Advance all valid members on the same discrete day index; scrub restores stored member ledgers, and band interpolation is display-only.
creative_affordances: Use small multiples or a translucent min/max ribbon with selectable member threads and a fixed shared-forcing rail.
known_limits: Scenario spread reflects only the finite supplied assumptions; it does not quantify omitted uncertainty, parameter likelihood, calibration quality or prediction accuracy.
No scenario calculation, field dataset, Blender export, render or Three.js runtime was executed.

claims.statement: FAO Paper 56 equations (85)-(88) provide the daily root-zone depletion bookkeeping used by the related root-zone budget; the finite scenario membership and min/max envelope in this recipe are explicitly authored comparison rules.
claims.scope: Underlying one-layer daily balance only; no probability distribution, confidence level or site-specific prescription is claimed.

source_refs.locator: Soil water balance, equations (85)-(88), plus Forecasting or allocating irrigations

object_craft.structure: Blender authors one neutral root-zone prism, shared forcing rail and reusable line/band glyphs; glTF transports static context and stable nodes, not scenario values.
object_craft.material: Member identity uses line pattern and labels as well as hue; a hatched envelope is distinct from literal soil water or groundwater.
object_craft.articulation: Three.js binds provenance-labeled ledgers, runs the related budget per scenario, derives the finite min/max band, exposes failures and resets membership/forcing.

physical_contract.scope: Finite deterministic composition of an existing daily root-zone ledger; descriptive scenario range only.
physical_contract.timestep: One shared daily index; each member uses the underlying recipe timestep and validity contract.
checks: Verify identical forcing hash for all members.
Compare envelope extrema against visible member ledgers.
Keep invalid members and non-probabilistic label visible.
